content.short: Stargate is a fully composable omnichain liquidity transport protocol enabling seamless native asset bridging across blockchains in a single transaction.
content.description: Stargate Finance, built on LayerZero, is a liquidity transport protocol that enables users and protocols to transfer native assets across blockchains in a single transaction with guaranteed instant finality. Unlike traditional bridges that use wrapped tokens, Stargate maintains unified liquidity pools on each chain so users always receive native assets on the destination. Since its launch in 2022, Stargate has processed billions in cross-chain volume and is integrated with Mantle to connect the network to all major EVM ecosystems.
content.meta: Stargate is a composable omnichain liquidity protocol enabling native asset bridging to and from Mantle. Discover Stargate on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
